label: Кодекс на труда — nothing new in the window
text: No КТ amendment was tabled or promulgated on 26–27 Oct: the last change was adopted on 25 Sep 2026 and published in Държавен вестник, while the next bill (signature 52-654-01-97, filed 16 Jul 2026) is still with the labour committee, last scheduled 15 Oct 2026 — so this bucket is status, not news.
